title: Procrustes-Bering-Sheaft: Automated Model Discovery and Virtual Crash Tests for Microservices
abstract: arXiv:2610.31444v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Procrustes-Bering-Sheaft automates lightweight model discovery and virtual crash tests for microservices. Each test estimates operation availability by Monte Carlo sampling of service and communication failures. Procrustes checks deployment and tracing evidence; Bering discovers dependencies and incorporates replica declarations; Sheaft evaluates declared operation-success conditions. Independent command-line interfaces exchange reusable, versioned artifacts. The toolchain extends an earlier graph-based approach with mandatory-call contracts, failure-tolerance sweeps, baseline comparison, component-importance analysis, and CI/CD gates. We demonstrate the workflow on one HTTP operation. Six controlled execution states exposed two mismatches between reachability and observed success; an explicit required-call predicate matched all six. translated_title: Procrustes-Bering-Sheaft：面向微服务的自动化模型发现与虚拟崩溃测试
translated_abstract: Procrustes-Bering-Sheaft 实现了面向微服务的轻量级模型发现与虚拟崩溃测试的自动化。每个测试通过蒙特卡洛采样服务和通信故障来估计操作的可用性。Procrustes 检查部署与追踪证据；Bering 发现依赖关系并纳入副本声明；Sheaft 评估所声明的操作成功条件。各工具通过独立的命令行接口交换可复用、带版本管理的工件。该工具链在早期基于图的方法基础上进行了扩展，新增了强制调用契约、故障容忍度扫描、基线比较、组件重要性分析以及 CI/CD 门禁。作者在一个 HTTP 操作上演示了该工作流程：六种受控执行状态暴露了可达性与实际观测成功之间的两处不匹配，而一个显式的必需调用谓词与全部六种状态相匹配。两次建模的单副本增加产生了不同的决策：推荐方案保留了可用性——（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了 Procrustes-Bering-Sheaft 工具链，通过蒙特卡洛故障采样自动化实现微服务的模型发现与虚拟崩溃测试，并能检测操作可达性与实际观测成功之间的不匹配。
en_tdlr: Procrustes-Bering-Sheaft is an automated toolchain that performs lightweight model discovery and virtual crash tests for microservices via Monte Carlo sampling of service and communication failures, detecting mismatches between reachability and observed operation success.
